about_the_game: A simple toy for your desktop where you push the pump button to shoot water and rings at the pegs. Rings that land on the pegs will turn green! Can you get all the rings to be green?
detailed_description: A simple toy for your desktop where you push the pump button to shoot water and rings at the pegs. Rings that land on the pegs will turn green! Can you get all the rings to be green?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: glibc 2.15+, 32/64-bit
  • Processor: 6th Generation Intel
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 530
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Lion 10.7.5, latest macOS release strongly recommended
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
